'''1999 Decipher World Championship Martin Akesson DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Martin Akesson]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds91.htm Ralltiir AT-STs], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050519045407/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds91.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
